_comment: AAT signal-generator sweep, SCOPE side - STP 8.6.3.2: capture the triangle sweep driven onto the ambient air temperature sensor signal (pair with the aat_triangle_gen function-generator config). Single channel, 1 V/div, vertical position -3.5 div, 100 s/div (a very wide, slow window - 1000 s across screen), edge trigger on CH1 rising at 2.5 V, AUTO (free-run) mode, RMS. NOTE: the wide 100 s/div window fits a SLOW sweep (see aat_triangle_gen - the STP's '1 MHz' is interpreted as 1 mHz to match this window and the smooth 0.1..4.9 V sweep verified in 8.6.4.3); confirm against the live STP. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts. The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=1000 to configure_scope for this test (1000 s total = 100 s/div x 10).
name: aat_triangle_scope
